projects.name: Next-Gen Mobile Application
projects.description: Cross-platform iOS & Android rebuild targeting 60fps animations and seamless offline synchronization.

projects.name: Design System 3.0 Refactor
projects.description: Unified tokenized component library built with Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives, and dark mode dynamics.

projects.name: Cloud Core & Realtime Engine
projects.description: High-throughput Edge API runtime, WebSocket state synchronization, and immutable client event log store.

projects.name: Q4 Global Rebranding Campaign
projects.description: Complete overhaul of corporate visual identity, tone of voice guidelines, media assets, and press kits.

projects.name: Enterprise Summit 2026 Keynote
projects.description: Annual developer & executive customer conference presentation, interactive demos, and keynote collateral.

projects.name: Customer Journey & Analytics Hub
projects.description: User retention telemetry, Net Promoter Score feedback aggregation, and onboarding conversion funnels.

tasks.title: Implement Biometric Auth Flow (FaceID / TouchID)
tasks.description: Integrate Native Keychain API with fallback PIN authentication for iOS & Android.

tasks.title: Optimize Offline SQLite Cache Synchronization
tasks.description: Ensure optimistic UI updates automatically queue and retry failed payload syncs upon network recovery.

tasks.title: Design Mobile Navigation Drawer & Bottom Tabs
tasks.description: Create responsive gesture-driven drawer navigation with smooth spring physics animations.

tasks.title: Configure Push Notifications with FCM & APNS
tasks.description: Set up silent background data pushes and user interaction handlers.

tasks.title: Audit Mobile Memory Leaks in Video Player
tasks.description: Investigate texture buffer allocation overhead on long scrollable feed lists.

tasks.title: Implement Deep Linking Scheme (`acme://task/:id`)
tasks.description: Enable universal links for external web previews and email notification redirects.

tasks.title: Add Haptic Feedback to Task Gesture Swipe Actions
tasks.description: Integrate subtle tactile vibration on swipe-to-complete and drag-and-drop ordering.

tasks.title: Setup Automated iOS App Store Fastlane Deployments
tasks.description: Script TestFlight build releases tied to main branch GitHub merge events.

tasks.title: Build In-App Crash Reporting & Sentry Diagnostics
tasks.description: Capture JS runtime exceptions and native stack traces with contextual breadcrumbs.

tasks.title: Refactor Dark Mode Color Tokens for OLED Displays
tasks.description: Replace dark gray backgrounds with true black `#000000` accents for battery optimization.

tasks.title: Migrate Color Palette to Tailwind v4 CSS Variables
tasks.description: Refactor root theme variables to OKLCH color space for dynamic contrast adjustment.

tasks.title: Build Accessible Data Table Component with Resizable Columns
tasks.description: Construct WCAG AAA compliant grid component with sorting, filtering, and keyboard navigation.

tasks.title: Create Interactive Command Palette (`Cmd + K`) Modal
tasks.description: Implement fuzzy search dialog for quick navigation across workspaces, tasks, and users.

tasks.title: Publish Storybook 8 Documentation & Live Demos
tasks.description: Generate auto-updating component documentation site hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

tasks.title: Design Glassmorphism Modal Dialog Primitive
tasks.description: Build backdrop-filter blur modal overlays with subtle noise textures and smooth scale-in transitions.

tasks.title: Extract Reusable Rich Text Editor with Slash Commands
tasks.description: Integrate Tiptap headless editor with custom task mention nodes and markdown exports.

tasks.title: Add Drag-and-Drop Kanban Board Component Primitives
tasks.description: Leverage HTML5 Drag API with collision detection and placement feedback.

tasks.title: Optimize Icon Library Tree-Shaking & Bundle Size
tasks.description: Replace heavy SVG bundle imports with dynamic inline SVG sprite system.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Select Tag Selector & Color Picker
tasks.description: Construct flexible tag pill component with color picker dropdown and search filtering.

tasks.title: Audit Keyboard Focus Rings Across All Interactive Buttons
tasks.description: Ensure focus-visible outline rings remain crisp across Chrome, Safari, and Firefox browsers.

tasks.title: Architect Client-Side Redux State Persistence Layer
tasks.description: Configure IndexedDB backed middleware for Redux Toolkit to preserve offline workspace snapshots.

tasks.title: Implement Optimistic UI Mutation Pipeline
tasks.description: Dispatch Redux actions immediately while logging undo/redo history in state store.

tasks.title: Design Event-Driven Activity Logger System
tasks.description: Create centralized event bus subscriber that logs all workspace mutations into local storage.

tasks.title: Build Client-Side Full-Text Search Engine with FlexSearch
tasks.description: Index workspace tasks, descriptions, and comments in memory for instantaneous search responses.

tasks.title: Construct Mock WebSockets Sync Gateway
tasks.description: Simulate multi-tab live sync notifications using BroadcastChannel browser API.

tasks.title: Develop Client JSON Import/Export Backup Engine
tasks.description: Allow users to export entire workspace store to JSON file and restore with schema validation.

tasks.title: Benchmark Large Dataset Rendering (>1,000 Tasks)
tasks.description: Profile React virtualization DOM list nodes using tanstack react virtual.

tasks.title: Write Schema Validation Middleware for Redux Slices
tasks.description: Verify incoming state payload shapes against Zod schemas on startup.

tasks.title: Implement Web Worker for Heavy Data Filtering & Sorting
tasks.description: Offload complex timeline gantt calculations off the main UI rendering thread.

tasks.title: Create Automated End-to-End Test Suite with Playwright
tasks.description: Cover drag-and-drop task movements, filter changes, and workspace switching.

tasks.title: Finalize 2026 Brand Guidelines Deck & Typography Rules
tasks.description: Publish revised brand typography system using Inter Display and JetBrains Mono fonts.

tasks.title: Design High-Resolution Vector Logo Variant Package
tasks.description: Generate monochrome, dark-mode, icon mark, and stacked brand logo SVGs.

tasks.title: Produce Marketing Hero Video & Motion Graphics
tasks.description: Render 4K promo video showcasing Notion-like canvas and Jira-like project boards.

tasks.title: Audit Social Media Image Banners & OG Meta Tags
tasks.description: Create dynamic OpenGraph social share card templates for Twitter, LinkedIn, and GitHub.

tasks.title: Refresh Corporate Email Newsletter Templates
tasks.description: Code responsive HTML email templates tested across Outlook, Gmail, and Apple Mail.

tasks.title: Write Product Positioning Statement & Tone Guidelines
tasks.description: Document clear copy rules for enterprise vs indie developer product messaging.

tasks.title: Create Merch & Swag Mockups for Developer Summit
tasks.description: Design branded hoodies, sticker sheets, mechanical keyboard keycaps, and water bottles.

tasks.title: Coordinate Press Release Distribution with PR Agency
tasks.description: Draft launch announcement embargoed for TechCrunch, ProductHunt, and HackerNews.

tasks.title: Build Digital Brand Asset Management (DAM) Portal
tasks.description: Construct public web gallery for press to download high-res logos and product mockups.

tasks.title: Conduct Competitor Visual Identity Comparison Study
tasks.description: Analyze visual trends across Linear, Monday.com, Notion, and Jira Enterprise.

tasks.title: Book Keynote Speakers & Finalize Conference Schedule
tasks.description: Confirm dates, contracts, and tech talks for 12 industry executive speakers.

tasks.title: Build Summit 2026 Registration & Ticket Web App
tasks.description: Construct responsive landing page with countdown timer and calendar export links.

tasks.title: Design Conference Badge & Access Pass Artwork
tasks.description: Create printable RFID badge templates for VIPs, speakers, sponsors, and attendees.

tasks.title: Set Up Live Stream Recording & Broadcasting Setup
tasks.description: Coordinate 4K multi-camera streaming setup for YouTube Live and Twitch broadcast.

tasks.title: Draft Executive Keynote Slide Deck & Product Demos
tasks.description: Prepare 45-minute keynote presentation outlining client-side architectural vision.

tasks.title: Coordinate Sponsor Booth Specifications & Assets
tasks.description: Send exhibitor guidelines and artwork dimension specs to 15 summit sponsors.

tasks.title: Create Mobile Event Schedule Companion App
tasks.description: Provide attendees with real-time room schedule updates and speaker Q&A submission.

tasks.title: Organize VIP Dinner & Executive Networking Reception
tasks.description: Reserve venue and confirm dietary preferences for 50 keynote speakers and sponsors.

tasks.title: Publish Post-Event Survey & Feedback Form
tasks.description: Draft rating questions for talks, venue quality, and product demo satisfaction.

tasks.title: Edit Keynote Highlights Video for Social Release
tasks.description: Cut 90-second hype video of top event moments for LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.

tasks.title: Synthesize Q3 Customer Churn & Retention Data
tasks.description: Analyze telemetry logs to identify top 3 friction points causing user drop-off.

tasks.title: Automate Post-Onboarding NPS Survey Trigger
tasks.description: Trigger subtle in-app rating modal after user creates their 5th active task.

tasks.title: Redesign User Onboarding Walkthrough Tour
tasks.description: Build interactive step-by-step tooltip guide introducing board views and shortcuts.

tasks.title: Publish Help Center Self-Service FAQ Articles
tasks.description: Write 15 detailed step-by-step guides covering keyboard navigation and filtering.

tasks.title: Audit Customer Support Ticket Resolution Velocity
tasks.description: Measure average time-to-first-response and customer satisfaction ratings.

tasks.title: Construct User Persona Mapping & Workflow Diagrams
tasks.description: Document core workflows for Product Managers, Tech Leads, and Content Creators.

tasks.title: Implement Feature Request Voting Portal
tasks.description: Allow users to upvote requested feature enhancements and track public roadmap status.

tasks.title: Analyze Heatmap Data of Task Modal Interactions
tasks.description: Review click-map telemetry to optimize position of task edit action buttons.

tasks.title: Conduct 10 One-on-One User Interviews with Power Users
tasks.description: Gather qualitative feedback on board view customizability and shortcut productivity.

tasks.title: Draft Archival Summary Report for Customer Insights Hub
tasks.description: Consolidate project findings into executive summary deck prior to project archival.
